types.name: Range and quartile deviation
types.description: Asks for the range, interquartile range, quartile deviation or their coefficients.

types.name: Mean deviation
types.description: Asks for the mean deviation about the mean or median, its coefficient, or about which value it is least.

types.name: Standard deviation and variance
types.description: Gives a list or table and asks for the standard deviation, variance or root mean square deviation.

types.name: Coefficient of variation
types.description: Asks for the CV, or which of two series, players or factories is more consistent or more variable.

types.name: Combined mean and SD
types.description: Gives sizes, means and SDs of two groups and asks for the SD or variance of both together.

types.name: Change of origin and scale
types.description: Says every value is increased, decreased, multiplied or transformed as y = a + bx and asks the new SD, variance or other measure.
